## Highlights
### Improved
- Open tabs when following them into another Space, with a setting to keep browsing in the current Space instead
### Fixed
- Keep embedded tracker frames from replacing the page with an extension blocking screen - Keep the spacebar available when searching from Start Page on iPhone and iPad - Keep swiping between Spaces working after changing a folder color on iPhone and iPad - Keep URL completions aligned with the cursor and replace them immediately as you type - Prevent remaining tabs from briefly jumping upward when closing tabs in the Mac sidebar - Keep incidental previews and notification sounds out of Now Playing, and clear playback controls when their media is gone
---
Nightly builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
[View all changes](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/compare/093ba706efdad74a87ffe9d178a322aab7ed5e89...c9a88d5429564925c0045df97b992f434ab22cc8) · [Download the installer](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/releases/download/nightly-0.5.96-2026-09-10-1082-r82.1/Installer-Crest-0.5.96-nightly-2026-09-10-c9a88d5-arm64.dmg)
[Browse Nightly releases](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/releases?q=prerelease%3Atrue+%22Nightly+builds%22)

## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 56 user-facing changes.
### New
- Use custom search engines with website icons and optional search suggestions in each Space - See update availability and control media from a global sidebar widget deck across Spaces
### Improved
- Follow new downloads into Downloads and see live size, progress, speed, and time remaining across Mac and iPhone
### Fixed
- Show blocked pop-ups in Site Controls with a one-step allow action - Keep loading pages on-brand, reuse an open Start Page, and search tabs only in the current Space - Keep Space navigation centered and Archive controls reachable as more Spaces are added - Continue typing with the same caret or selection after returning to a webpage tab on Mac - Use compatible browser extension actions directly from webpage context menus - Keep mouse back and forward navigation within the webpage or sidebar under the pointer - Keep new-window links inside Peek and Quick Window instead of hiding them in background tabs - Start loading tabs opened from links right away, with an option to select them automatically - Refresh available updates to the newest eligible build before downloading
---
Stable releases are signed, notarized, and ready for everyday use.
